scope: Mutual-top-q edge sets on fixed full candidate pool. Common-edge phi correlation is selected descriptive, not all-pair replication. q10 edge nesting within q20 is a deterministic consequence of the neighbor rule, not a new scientific observation.
interpretation: Separate pair-edge repeatability from community partition repeatability; changing q may reorganize communities even though the q10 edges are retained. Do not call all relations unstable from partition statistics alone.
